label: Huawei P30 smartphone
description: Huawei P30 — 6.1-inch 2019 flagship, Wi-Fi 5 (802.11ac, 2x2) and LTE only; USB-C 3.1 port with Ethernet over adapter.
notes: Wi-Fi 5 (802.11ac, 2x2 MIMO, 2.4/5 GHz, 80 MHz) — no Wi-Fi 6, no 160 MHz. Cellular: LTE Cat 21 only, no 5G at all (Kirin 980). USB-C 3.1 Gen 1 supports Ethernet adapters (usb0). Still common in labs as a pre-5G, pre-WPA3 client; EMUI supports WPA2-Enterprise but not WPA3-SAE on this generation.
